## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the [core principles](https://github.com/modarresi1913/Evoguard#-core-principles) of EvoGuard
- [ ] I have not introduced any feature that claims to detect AI-generated code with certainty
- [ ] I have not introduced any auto-merge behavior driven by score alone
- [ ] If I added new content, I have updated the relevant section of the [README](https://github.com/modarresi1913/Evoguard/blob/main/README.md)
- [ ] If I added new mock data, I updated `src/lib/evoguard/mock-data.ts`
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] I have not committed secrets, `.env` files, or local database files (see `.gitignore`)
